findings.text: Acceptance 1/4: subsequent renders ignore the server read watermark. Node DOM-harness reproduction: setup(520); await open(); cancelMarkRead(); append others' messages 512/514; renderMessages() yields highlighted=[512,514], expected [] (base commit yields []). The cached list ends at 510, so floor=510 while read remains 0. Initialize and maintain the confirmed watermark from server state, independently of the displayed list.

Acceptance 7: the account-change test masks missing cleanup. An in-memory Node mutation replacing hlMap's `if (gen !== hlGeneration)` with `if (hlGeneration === -1)` still passes all 17 tests. setup(504) calls resetUnreadHighlights(), hiding account leakage; tick(400) also never reaches A's 3000 ms fade timer. Initialize B without the test-only reset, advance past A's timer, and require the cleanup mutation to fail.
